question: IL12RB2 sQTL
result: No rs6679356-IL12RB2 sQTL in GTEx v10; detected sQTLs belong to SERBP1.
consequence: No splice-mediated causal chain can be claimed.

question: Soluble transcript
result: Ensembl transcripts lacking the canonical transmembrane segment are annotation-level candidates only.
consequence: Retain only as a testable mechanism.

question: Reviewed UniProt isoform
result: Reviewed truncated isoforms retain a transmembrane segment and are not validated soluble receptors.
consequence: Do not label reviewed isoforms as soluble IL12RB2.

question: CSF pQTL direction
result: T increases measured CSF IL12RB2 protein (beta 0.296, P=3.3e-23), opposite to its RNA effect.
consequence: Protein abundance cannot be used to infer receptor-pathway direction.

question: ARIC/INTERVAL primary pQTL
result: Primary protein signals do not overlap the FinnGen PBC credible set at signal level.
consequence: Do not use circulating protein as the main mediator.

question: MESA Olink-SomaScan agreement
result: 8647 aligned cis variants; Pearson z=-0.084, Spearman z=-0.070.
consequence: Cross-platform protein evidence is not reproducible.

question: MESA Olink-SomaScan coloc sensitivity
result: PP.H4 range 0.0009 to 0.0166 across stated priors.
consequence: No cross-platform shared protein signal is supported.
